evidence.description: requestAPNConsent directly invokes the operational UIApplication.shared service to register for remote notifications.

Notification helpers obtain UNUserNotificationCenter through current(), configure its categories and delegate, and retrieve notification settings rather than receiving a replaceable service dependency.
In-app message delegate callbacks directly invoke Analytics.shared.brazeIAM to record view, dismiss, and click events.

candidates.explanation: BrazeService directly obtains operational notification and analytics services through global singleton accessors instead of an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary. These accesses perform registration, notification-center configuration and queries, and analytics recording; they are not singleton declarations or shared configuration constants.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
